metadata.methodology: Structured empirical collection of 34 publicly accessible job postings across company career pages (NTT DATA, Cognizant, Airolabs.ai, Akraya, Tiger Analytics) and Indian/global job boards (Shine.com, Foundit.in, Cutshort.io, Hirist.tech, NextLeap, Indeed India, Jobgether). Postings were deduplicated and stratified into Entry-Level/Fresher (0-2 yrs), Mid-Level (2-5 yrs), and Senior/Benchmark (5+ yrs) cohorts so senior architecture requirements are never conflated with universal entry-level expectations.
metadata.workspaceInspectionFinding: Inspected /working_dir/c_4d4f5b8e7fffa3a0, /tmp, and connected Google Drive on 2026-10-22: no existing .html, .css, or .js file was attached to the session. This platform preserves and upgrades the classic 60-day bootcamp workflow and includes a built-in Legacy HTML / LocalStorage Importer & Merger so any existing local HTML file or JSON state can be merged directly in the browser without data loss.
metadata.runtimeBoundaryDisclosure: Strict No-External-AI-API Architecture: Static browser applications hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages cannot perform live cross-origin web scraping of job boards or invoke paid LLM APIs without exposing keys or running a backend proxy. Therefore, live research was executed at build time (2026-10-22), embedded as a structured replaceable JSON dataset (window.BOOTCAMP_RESEARCH_DATA), and paired with a deterministic client-side DAG Curriculum Generator, a Heuristic + Rubric JD Analyzer, and a JSON Research Dataset Importer.
limitations: LinkedIn and Naukri authenticated walls were not scraped per ethical access-control constraints; only publicly accessible pages and indexed listings were recorded.

Pure 'Microsoft Fabric' job titles in India frequently request 3-7 years of experience; however, 0-3 year Data Analyst, BI Developer, and Associate Data Engineer roles increasingly list Fabric/OneLake/Power BI as a high-value differentiator alongside core SQL, Python, and DAX.

Exam DP-203 (Azure Data Engineer Associate) was officially retired by Microsoft on March 31, 2025; Exam DP-700 (Fabric Data Engineer Associate) and Exam DP-600 (Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate) are the current active engineering credentials alongside PL-300.

certifications.title: Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate
weights: Implement and manage an analytics solution (30-35%): Workspace/Spark/OneLake settings, Git lifecycle & deployment pipelines, RLS/CLS/OLS/file-level security, dynamic data masking, sensitivity labels, orchestration with pipelines/notebooks/Dataflows Gen2.

Ingest and transform data (30-35%): Full & incremental loads, dimensional model prep, OneLake shortcuts & mirroring, PySpark/SQL/KQL transformations, handling duplicates/missing/late-arriving data, Eventstream & Spark Structured Streaming.

Monitor and optimize an analytics solution (30-35%): Monitor ingestion/transformation/semantic refresh, troubleshoot pipeline/dataflow/notebook/T-SQL/shortcut errors, optimize Lakehouse tables, Spark skew/shuffles, pipelines, and warehouses.
certifications.prerequisites: Solid SQL, Python/PySpark fundamentals, and Medallion Lakehouse concepts (covered in Days 1-52).

certifications.title: Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate
certifications.status: Active (Ideal Bridge for Analysts + Analytics Engineers)
weights: Maintain a data analytics solution (25-30%): Workspace/item access controls, RLS/CLS/OLS, sensitivity labels, endorsement, Git version control, .pbip projects, deployment pipelines, XMLA endpoint.
Prepare data (45-50%): OneLake catalog, Lakehouse vs Warehouse vs Eventhouse selection, views/stored procedures, Star Schema design, Dataflows Gen2 / SQL / KQL / Visual query editor transformations.

Implement and manage semantic models (25-30%): Storage modes (Import, DirectQuery, Direct Lake on OneLake vs SQL endpoint), Star Schema relationships, DAX iterators/variables/windowing, Calculation Groups, Field Parameters, Performance Analyzer & Incremental Refresh.
certifications.prerequisites: SQL, Dimensional Modeling (Star Schema), Power Query, and DAX (covered in Days 1-36).

certifications.title: Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate
certifications.status: Active (Industry Standard for Data Analysts & BI Developers)
weights: Prepare the data (25-30%): Connect to sources, DirectLake/DirectQuery/Import selection, Power Query profiling, merge/append, pivot/unpivot, query folding.

Model the data (25-30%): Star Schema cardinality & cross-filter direction, role-playing dimensions, common date table, DAX CALCULATE/Time Intelligence/semi-additive measures, Performance Analyzer & DAX Query View.
Visualize and analyze the data (25-30%): Visual selection, custom tooltips, bookmarks, drillthrough, conditional formatting, visual calculations, accessibility, anomaly detection.
Manage and secure Power BI (15-20%): Workspaces, Apps, gateways, scheduled refresh, Row-Level Security (RLS), sensitivity labels.
certifications.prerequisites: Excel/CSV literacy, SQL basics, and Power BI Desktop (covered in Days 1-36).

certifications.title: Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate
certifications.status: RETIRED on March 31, 2025 — Do Not Register
weights: Important Market Reality: Many HR job descriptions in India still copy-paste 'DP-203' in their preferred qualifications (e.g., Airolabs.ai, Planview, Cognizant). However, Microsoft retired DP-203 on March 31, 2025. Candidates should earn DP-700 (Fabric Data Engineer Associate) and list 'DP-700 (Microsoft's official successor to DP-203 Azure Data Engineer)' on their resume so ATS scanners match both keywords.

booksLibrary.focus: Understand how the VertiPaq columnar engine compresses data, why Row Context does not automatically filter tables without context transition (CALCULATE), and why filtering whole tables Instead of columns kills report performance.
